decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Design and Access Statement, EGA009, EGA008, EGA007, EGA006, EGA005, EGA004, EGA003, EGA002, EGA001, Site Location, Topographic map, Sustainable Drainage Systems, Existing Site and Proposed Plans, Environment Agency Flood Maps, Environment Agency Data and Information, Geological Map, Flood Risk Assessment Report, Flood matrix, Unnumbered location plan, PGA008, PGA007, PGA006, PGA005, PGA004, PGA003, PGA002, PGA001 received 12/02/2026].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the [insert] elevation shall be obscure-glazed and non-opening below 1.7 metres above internal floor level. The windows shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than in accordance with the requirements of this condition. 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' privacy

Condition : 5 - The dwelling house, as enlarged and/or altered in accordance with this permission, shall only be used as a single unit of accommodation, and shall not be subdivided, separated or altered in any way so as to create two or more separate units of accommodation, without further grant of planning permission.
Reason: In order to prevent the creation, by conversion, of additional and inappropriate units of accommodation at this site, which may lead to an over intensive use of the site.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, front porch extension and part first floor rear extension with Juliet balcony. Demolition of existing garage and erection of a single storey side extension with new front access door to cycle store, installation of new access door to front boot room. Installation of doors and aluminium windows to the house. Replacement of front hanging tiles with render.
